paragraphs.text: Gonzalo Ferreira Luján participated in Founding of Red del Horizonte Azul on 2010-05-30. Red del Horizonte Azul was linked to Founding of Red del Horizonte Azul on 2010-05-30. Founding of Red del Horizonte Azul occurred at Tijuana on 2010-05-30. A currency exchange audit conducted in the border region surfaced a cluster of cash deposits in Tijuana and Ensenada that the examining officer tied to the formation of a new crossing service. The officer's narrative, drawn from interviews with exchange staff, describes Ferreira, a former fishing fleet owner known along the coast as El Timonel, as the figure who brought tunnel crews and panga operators under one arrangement that charged other groups a fee per load crossed.

Teodoro Lizárraga Fonseca participated in Founding of Red del Horizonte Azul on 2010-05-30. Founding of Red del Horizonte Azul transited Tijuana crossing plaza on 2010-05-30. Red del Horizonte Azul controlled Tijuana crossing plaza from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. Exchange staff identified Lizárraga, called El Cerrajero for his reputed skill with locks and tunnel doors, as the person who brought the cash to the counters. The examining officer assessed from the deposit pattern that the arrangement took effect at the Tijuana crossing immediately and that no competing crossing service operated in the city afterward without paying the fee.

Gonzalo Ferreira Luján led Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. Gonzalo Ferreira Luján was a member of Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. The examining officer characterized Ferreira as the sole decision maker for the arrangement in its early years. The reporting office notes that the audit narrative rests on exchange staff interviews and deposit records rather than on direct observation of the founding. The company and vessel names in this report were provided by the source and checked against registry extracts. The reporting office requests that any related seizure data be shared with the originating desk.
